domain_entities.name: LeaveRequestStatus
domain_entities.purpose: Enumeration of all possible lifecycle states for a LeaveRequest

domain_entities.name: LeaveRequest
domain_entities.purpose: Core aggregate root representing an employee's leave application, tracking its full lifecycle from draft through approval/rejection/cancellation

domain_entities.name: LeaveType
domain_entities.purpose: Enumeration of leave categories. Each type maps to a LeavePolicy that governs entitlement, accrual, and approval rules.

domain_entities.name: LeavePolicy
domain_entities.purpose: Defines the rules and entitlements for a specific leave type. Each LeaveType has exactly one active LeavePolicy at any time. Controls accrual, accumulation caps, notice periods, and whether manager approval is required.

domain_entities.name: LeaveBalance
domain_entities.purpose: Tracks an employee's leave entitlement, consumption, and remaining balance for a specific leave type within a single fiscal year. Deducted on approval; restored on cancellation of approved leave.

business_rules: A LeaveRequest can only transition from DRAFT to SUBMITTED (by the employee), from SUBMITTED to APPROVED or REJECTED (by the manager), from SUBMITTED or APPROVED to CANCELLED (by the employee or an admin). Once in APPROVED, REJECTED, or CANCELLED, the request is terminal — no further transitions are allowed. DRAFT requests can also be deleted outright. [BINDING RULE — apply this wherever LeaveRequest appears, not only here]

Leave duration in days is calculated inclusively: days = endDate - startDate + 1. Both the start date and end date count as leave days consumed from the balance. This formula applies universally — to balance deduction on approval, to balance restoration on cancellation, and to all sufficiency checks. [BINDING RULE — apply this wherever LeaveRequest, LeaveBalance appears, not only here]

When a LeaveRequest transitions to APPROVED, the employee's LeaveBalance for the matching leaveType and fiscalYear must be debited: usedDays increases by the inclusive day count, remainingDays decreases by the same amount. If remainingDays reaches zero, the balance status transitions to EXHAUSTED. [BINDING RULE — apply this wherever LeaveRequest, LeaveBalance appears, not only here]

When an APPROVED LeaveRequest is CANCELLED, the employee's LeaveBalance must be credited: usedDays decreases by the inclusive day count, remainingDays increases by the same amount. If the balance was EXHAUSTED and remainingDays becomes positive, the balance status returns to ACTIVE. [BINDING RULE — apply this wherever LeaveRequest, LeaveBalance appears, not only here]

Before a LeaveRequest can be SUBMITTED or APPROVED, the system must verify that the employee has sufficient remainingDays in their LeaveBalance for the requested leaveType and fiscalYear. If remainingDays < the inclusive day count of the request, the operation must be rejected with an insufficient-balance error. This check is skipped for unpaid leave types. [BINDING RULE — apply this wherever LeaveRequest, LeaveBalance appears, not only here]

If the LeavePolicy for the requested leaveType has requiresManagerApproval = true, the LeaveRequest must be approved by the employee's manager (employee.managerId). If requiresManagerApproval = false, the request auto-approves on submission. Emergency and sick leave types always require manager approval regardless of policy setting. [BINDING RULE — apply this wherever LeaveRequest, LeavePolicy appears, not only here]

When a LeavePolicy has a minimumNoticeDays value, the startDate of any LeaveRequest for that leaveType must be at least minimumNoticeDays calendar days after the submission date. The notice period is calculated as: startDate - submissionDate >= minimumNoticeDays (calendar days, not business days). Emergency leave is exempt from this rule. [BINDING RULE — apply this wherever LeaveRequest, LeavePolicy appears, not only here]

Only the employee who owns the LeaveRequest (employeeId) may submit a DRAFT or cancel a SUBMITTED/APPROVED request. Only the employee's designated manager (employee.managerId) may approve or reject a SUBMITTED request. An admin role may override and perform any transition. [BINDING RULE — apply this wherever LeaveRequest appears, not only here]
startDate must be on or before endDate. A LeaveRequest with startDate > endDate is invalid at creation and at any update. [BINDING RULE — apply this wherever LeaveRequest appears, not only here]

A LeaveRequest cannot overlap with another APPROVED or SUBMITTED LeaveRequest for the same employee. Overlap is defined as any day intersection between [startDate, endDate] intervals (inclusive). [BINDING RULE — apply this wherever LeaveRequest appears, not only here]

A LeaveBalance is scoped to a single fiscalYear. The fiscalYear is determined from the LeaveRequest's startDate: if startDate's month is January–June, fiscalYear = startDate's year; if July–December, fiscalYear = startDate's year + 1. This mirrors a July–June fiscal calendar. [BINDING RULE — apply this wherever LeaveBalance appears, not only here]
domain_notes:
## Lifecycle states introduced

### LeaveRequestStatus (enum)
- DRAFT → SUBMITTED (employee submits)
- SUBMITTED → APPROVED (manager approves)
- SUBMITTED → REJECTED (manager rejects)
- SUBMITTED → CANCELLED (employee or admin cancels)
- APPROVED → CANCELLED (employee or admin cancels)
- DRAFT → deleted (employee deletes outright)
- APPROVED, REJECTED, CANCELLED are terminal states

### LeavePolicy lifecycle
- ACTIVE: policy is in effect and governs leave requests
- INACTIVE: policy is retired; no new requests can reference it

### LeaveBalance lifecycle
- ACTIVE: balance has remainingDays > 0 and fiscal year is current
- EXHAUSTED: remainingDays = 0 (triggered on approval when balance hits zero)
- CLOSED: fiscal year has ended; balance is archived and no longer debited/credited

### Key cross-entity rules
- Balance deduction on APPROVED; balance restoration on CANCELLED (of an APPROVED request)
- Inclusive day count: days = endDate - startDate + 1 (universal)
- Sufficiency check before SUBMIT/APPROVE against remainingDays
- Manager approval gating via LeavePolicy.requiresManagerApproval + employee.managerId
- Minimum notice period enforcement (calendar days, emergency-exempt)
- No overlapping APPROVED/SUBMITTED requests for same employee
- RBAC: employee owns submit/cancel; manager owns approve/reject; admin overrides all
- Fiscal year mapping from startDate (open question on exact rule)

open_questions.question: How is the fiscal year determined for leave balances? The domain model includes fiscalYear but the mapping rule (calendar year Jan–Dec, fiscal year Jul–Jun, or company-specific) is not specified in the feature description.
open_questions.impact: Affects which LeaveBalance a LeaveRequest draws from, how annual entitlements reset, and how carry-over (if any) is calculated.
candidate_options: July–June fiscal: fiscalYear = startDate month >= 7 ? startDate year + 1 : startDate year
Configurable per tenant/company via a system setting

open_questions.question: Do unused leave days carry over to the next fiscal year, and if so, what is the cap?
open_questions.impact: Determines whether LeaveBalances are reset to entitlementDays each fiscal year or whether remainingDays from the prior year are added. Affects balance lifecycle transitions (CLOSED state semantics).
candidate_options: No carry-over: unused days are forfeited at fiscal year end
Full carry-over: unused days roll into next fiscal year up to maxAccumulation
Partial carry-over: a capped portion of unused days rolls over

open_questions.question: What is the minimum granularity of leave — full days, half-days, or hours?
open_questions.impact: Affects the inclusive day-count formula (BR on day calculation), balance precision (integer vs decimal), and overlap detection logic.
candidate_options: Half-day: minimum leave duration is 0.5 days
Full-day only: minimum leave duration is 1 day
Hourly: leave can be taken in hourly increments

open_questions.question: Do weekends and public holidays count as leave days consumed from the balance?
open_questions.impact: Directly affects the inclusive day-count formula and balance deduction amounts. If business-days-only, the system needs a calendar of working days and holidays.
candidate_options: Calendar days: weekends and holidays count as leave days consumed
Business days only: only working days are deducted from balance
Configurable per leave type or policy
